title: Type B Reflexivization as an Unambiguous Testbed for Multilingual Multi-Task Gender Bias

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating unambiguous model prediction errors across four NLP tasks (Natural Language Inference, Machine Translation, Coreference Resolution, and Language Modeling) using a multilingual challenge dataset based on Type B reflexivization grammatical rules, and correlating these errors with real-world occupational gender statistics.
